title: Engram Work detail reads do not stop when their HTTP handler is abandoned
outcome: Pre-existing behavior, outside the Beads removal: get_project_work_detail in src/work_visualizer_detail.rs:169–186 creates no WorkReadAbandonGuard and passes no cancellation flag into read_project_work_detail_with_admission. An aborted detail handler can still acquire capacity and run show, unlike list/memories. Add bounded cancellation ownership and discriminating no-spawn-after-abort coverage without changing ordinary reader identity/cursor behavior. Broader abandoned-read starvation and interruptible permit waiting are tracked separately by w-5567217e796c and w-553d32957dda; this item is the detail route's missing guard/wiring.
acceptance: Engram Work detail reads do not stop when their HTTP handler is abandoned is done
